name: Lake Temagami
blurb: Contour-derived bathymetry from a 1969 MNRF transect survey (year from the LIO bathymetry index; contour feature dates are null in LIO). No depth soundings exist for this lake - depths are interpolated between the survey contours and capped at 79.3 m; confidence is strictly distance-to-contour (72.0% of water cells at >=0.4). Cold-regime lake; lake trout, walleye (BsM: 63 sets) and cisco in the ARA community. Secchi 5.3 m (ARA).
